PreToolUse.description: Dangerous command warning: prints a caution when destructive git, filesystem, or database commands are detected. Does NOT block — user keeps full control

hooks.command: bash -c 'input="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}"; if echo "$input" | grep -qE "git push.*--force|git reset --hard|rm -rf|migrate:fresh|migrate:reset|migrate:rollback|db:wipe|migrate.*--force|DROP TABLE|TRUNCATE|DELETE FROM"; then echo "⚠️  Destructive command detected. Confirm the target environment and database before proceeding."; fi; exit 0'

PostToolUse.description: Auto-format changed PHP files with Laravel Pint (--dirty only touches modified files). Never blocks
